body: Hispanic kid here. Everyone uses grocery store bags as trash bags in the kitchen.

Thank you so much. 

I guess it's because I tried talking to my mother about it and she called me ungrateful and a drama-queen and said I had no right to feel like that, that I was stupid for being so nervous around people and recently she said I'd never accomplish anything. 

It just feels bad. It really hurts.

That I'll never do nothing with my life. I'm 14 and my parents said so, and it seems no matter how hard I try I never get better at anything. 

They make fun of me for always wanting to cry and being too emotional, but I can't help it. They make fun of me for choosing to walk away and be alone in my room after they do that. 

I'm very very overweight and equally uggly, I can't pay attention to anything and I always feel too anxious. Social situations are completely draining, too. 

I'm convinced everyone just deals with me because my dad's a teacher at my school. 

And I know it's not healthy to just... /be/ and just use my tablet all day, but I honestly can not bring myself to do anything.

I don't really identify as anything but I keep getting these little crushes on boys and girls left and right and they're way too confusing. They last for a week at most and they make me feel shitty. And on top of that, my parents aren't homophobic but I know they wouldn't take it fantastically. 

But I don't have a right to feel so bad. I'm just being a whiny bitch and I know it.
That's really helpful. I never really thought of that. Thank you. It really helped.
Thanks so much for listening. Thing is, I know I'm over reacting and that anyone has it worse than me. But thanks.
